# Ángel Guerra

> Personal website of Ángel Guerra, a Full Stack Developer from Cantabria, Spain. This site contains a professional biography, employment history and contact information.

This website is intentionally small and primarily textual. It is written in English and focuses on professional experience rather than acting as a traditional portfolio.

## Biography

Ángel Guerra is a Full Stack Developer with more than ten years of professional experience building business software, web applications and APIs.

His career spans software consultancies and product companies across industries including automotive, insurance, legal-tech, pharmaceuticals and sports. He specialises in Ruby, Ruby on Rails and JavaScript, with extensive experience delivering maintainable software and collaborating in technical planning, code reviews and product discussions.

### Highlights

- 10+ years of professional experience.

- Experienced in technical leadership, code reviews and planning.
